text:
zara: Noticed a jump in apiserver p95 and controller-manager reconcile failures in eu-west1 around 09:02. Leader election churn starting at 09:03.
sam: confirmed. watch latency alert fired, backlog ~6.2k. etcd apply latency spiked in the same window.
noah: GPU attach errors beginning at 09:04 in the kubelet logs: 
```
W0903 09:04:12.512 kubelet.go:123] attach failed: POST https://nvproxy.internal:5040/attach 504 GATEWAY_TIMEOUT
```
noah: tcpdump from a node shows excessive retransmits to our NAT gateway and SNAT counters incrementing fast.
zara: any recent infra changes? ops-bot: infra-pipeline rolled egress-qos v1.2 to eu-west1 at 09:00 with eBPF shaping rules.
sam: looking at `tc -s qdisc` on an affected host: fq_codel plus clsact with packet drops in ingress filter. High-priority control-plane traffic appears classified into the default class.
noah: can we whitelist 6443/2379/2380? Rolling out a bypass seems low-friction. Reverting the whole rollout is heavier.
zara: prefer targeted bypass first; apply to a canary set of 5 nodes and watch etcd leader heartbeats and watch backlog.
sam: added iptables MARK rule on node-eu-07 and updated eBPF policy to skip marked packets. Monitoring now.
(90s) sam: metrics update: watch backlog down 6.2k -> 540, etcd apply latency normalized, leader elections quieting.
noah: GPU attach success rate on node-eu-07 recovered. Other nodes still ~60% attach failure.
zara: pausing further egress-qos rollout and tagging it rollback-blocker. ops-bot: pipeline flagged as paused by @zara.
sam: follow-ups: 1) INFRA-1001: add control-plane port bypass to eBPF default profile; 2) INFRA-1002: presubmit perf test that generates small-burst control-plane traffic and validates zero-drop; owners @noah @sam.
noah: billing-bot: estimate for idle GPU minutes during the incident window (~20m) in eu-west1 is ~$2.1k. Logged to cost-signal channel.
zara: root cause hypothesis: eBPF shaping classifier mis-sorted encrypted control-plane flows (SNI-less) into the bulk class, causing head-of-line drops and NAT retransmits -> etcd/apply latency -> controller-manager backpressure.
sam: mitigation plan: backfill bypass, add tc qdisc drift monitor in node-config-checker, and add a k8s alert for watch-channel-blocked > 30s.
oops: thanks team, good isolation and quick partial rollback. :shipit:
